options.name: 하루의 문
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE professional logo concept presentation for the Korean travel planning app "군번여지도" (Gunbeon Yeojido). This app helps young soldiers and their parents, partners and friends plan a shared day trip in Gangwon, then return and record their memories. It is a warm contemporary TRAVEL brand.
Concept A: "A doorway into a shared day." Design a distinctive compact OPEN PASSPORT / OPEN DOOR symbol that subtly contains a rising sun. Two substantial curved folded-page shapes form one asymmetric upright gateway; a broad clean white opening between them is also a path into the day. One small warm apricot sun is nestled inside the upper opening. Make the page-to-door transformation clever and legible, not a literal illustration of a book or building. A bold, friendly iconic silhouette; two or three solid shapes at most, carefully balanced negative space, no hairlines, sophisticated optical geometry with gently rounded outer corners. Should still be recognizable at 24px and beautiful at 140px.
Flat vector-style finish, crisp edges, no texture, no shading. Deep sea teal #246568 as dominant symbol color; warm apricot #D68755 only for the single sun. Pure white background.
Square presentation, generous white margins, primary symbol centered in the upper-middle around 52% of canvas width. Below it place the exact Korean wordmark "군번여지도" in polished bold contemporary Korean sans-serif, dark teal, excellent kerning. Below that a small "강원". Text must be exactly 군 / 번 / 여 / 지 / 도, with no slash marks or extra letters. No other text. This is ONE logo proposal, not a sheet of variations.
Avoid generic location pins, mountains, compass needles, shields, military insignia, medals, guns, camouflage, flags, hearts, app-store mockups, 3D effects, gradients, stock clip-art, ornamental stamp borders. Render a considered designer-created original travel identity.

options.name: 다시 만나는 길
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE professional logo concept presentation for the Korean travel planning app "군번여지도" (Gunbeon Yeojido), where soldiers and parents, partners or friends create a shared trip with time to return. The brand should feel welcoming, memorable and modern.
Concept B: "The path that brings us together again." Make a compact, bold flowing ROUTE RIBBON symbol, almost a lowercase g / rounded G viewed as an abstract journey with a beginning and return. Use one thick teal looping band with a distinctive open diagonal gap and an inset return bend, plus one short apricot ribbon segment fitting the gap to represent a companion joining. The central white negative space is a clearly visible continuous turn, not an extra line. This should be a custom organic geometric brand glyph, neither an ordinary printed G nor a recycling arrow. Its silhouette is broadly rounded and flowing, with an interesting asymmetric terminal; substantially different from a book, gateway or four-square window. Use two flat color shapes only. A high-impact symbol that a person could roughly draw from memory, legible as a single silhouette at 24px and 140px.
Flat vector-style finish, precise clean edges, no shading or texture. Deep sea teal #246568 for the main ribbon and warm apricot #D68755 for the companion segment, pure white background.
Square presentation, generous white margins, primary symbol centered in the upper-middle around 52% of canvas width. Below it put the exact Korean wordmark "군번여지도" in polished bold contemporary Korean sans-serif, dark teal, excellent spacing. Below that a small "강원". Text must be exactly 군 / 번 / 여 / 지 / 도 with no slash marks or extra letters. No other text. ONE concept only.
Avoid hearts, infinity signs, chain links, people pictograms, map pins, arrowheads, military motifs, compass or generic mountain icons, template branding, gradients, shadows, 3D, device mockups, decorative borders. The mark must feel like an ownable premium travel app identity rather than a transport company or bank.

options.name: 강원의 네 창
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE high-quality logo concept presentation for the Korean shared travel app "군번여지도" (Gunbeon Yeojido). Its signature course covers are made of up to four windows, each showing one stop in a journey through Gangwon.
Concept C: "Four windows, one journey." Create a distinctive compact symbol built from FOUR broad geometric window/paper-tile forms arranged in an asymmetric 2-by-2 composition. Unify them with a generous meandering white passage through the center, suggesting moving between stops. Three forms are deep teal; the upper-right form is a warm apricot curved sun-like window that breaks the square silhouette slightly. Outer curves and flat inner cuts must be optically deliberate and a little playful. The result is a SINGLE clever emblem, not a grid of separate icons. Let landscape and daylight be implied by contours and negative space, with NO literal mountain drawing, NO tiny scenes inside. Avoid four identical squares or clover/pinwheel symmetry; make the top-right curve and central white passage distinct. Warm, clear and memorable at 24px and 140px. This logo's silhouette should be squarish and modular, visibly unlike a loop or an open book.
Flat vector-style illustration, precise solid shapes, clean sharp edges, no shading. Deep sea teal #246568 dominant, one warm apricot #D68755 shape, pure white background.
Square presentation with generous white margins, primary symbol centered in the upper-middle around 52% of canvas width. Under it put the exact Korean wordmark "군번여지도" in a polished bold contemporary Korean sans-serif, dark teal, excellent kerning. Small "강원" centered below. Exact syllables 군 / 번 / 여 / 지 / 도 with no slash marks or extra characters. No other text. ONE concept only.
Avoid Microsoft-like equal squares, Slack-like pill cross, generic flower marks, map pins, compass icons, passports with decorative borders, flags, shields, medals, military insignia, camouflage, gradients, shadows, texture, device mockups or marketing layouts. Refined independent travel brand, not generic government clip-art.
